text:
harper: opened a tiny docs PR to add a compact observability quick card: shows a cost/latency row, a short table of hit vs miss unit costs, and two micro-snippets (TS + bash cURL) that demonstrate tracekey grouping. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1450 :sparkles:

kevin: looks useful. can you link by dashboard ID so names don't drift? use https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/DB-520-obsv-compact

harper: switched to DB-520 link. kept examples to ~4 lines each for the quick card. pasted below.

harper: ```ts
// TypeScript: attach tracekey for cost rollup by prefix
await client.generate({model: 'gpt-small', input: prompt, metadata: {tracekey: 'productX/featureA'}})
// server: on cache hit -> metrics.inc('kv_cache_hits')
```

harper: ```bash
# curl: include tracekey header; useful for quick demos
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Tracekey: acct-9/promo" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# server-side: map header to tracekey and increment kv_cache_hits
```

tess: couple of asks: 1) our console cost panels expect alias kv_cache_hit_total; please add migration troubleshooting: "If charts show zeros, confirm alias mapping kv_cache_hits -> kv_cache_hit_total and check deploy redirect." 2) add TTL note: short TTL -> more misses -> higher token spend.

harper: added migration triage line + TTL sentence. Also included a one-line sampling note: "span sampling < 1.0 will sparsify latency traces; recommend 0.1 for staging."

kevin: nit: prefer header name X-Tracekey in examples? consistent with other quick cards. also please add a short line suggesting to reference dashboard by ID in support tickets.

harper: updated header to X-Tracekey and added support-tip to reference DB-520 in tickets.

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #1450 but linkcheck flagged external console link; please add an allowlist comment if external link is intentional.

infra-bot: FYI platform alias update scheduled in next deploy window (03:00 UTC). we'll create a redirect to DB-520 post-deploy.

harper: action items: 1) infra to push alias redirect 2) kevin to confirm runtime emits kv_cache_hits mapping in staging 3) tess to quick-verify wording 4) harper to squash and request final review. will ping when CI comment is addressed. thanks all :pray:
